review_scope: development-only science expansion; no train/validation/test assignment and no model use
method: Verified DOI, title, complete author list, electronic publication date, copyright holder and article-specific CC BY 4.0 permissions in all 12 pinned JATS XML files.
Reviewed the opening and closing rendered blocks and section structure of all 12 articles.
Searched every rendered file for XML markup, replacement characters and content declared as excluded by the renderer.
Reviewed all 66 document comparisons and all threshold matches among 416 screened cross-document paragraphs.

editorial_notes: Title, available abstract, section headings, paragraphs and lists are retained.
Figures, tables, supplementary content, bibliography and administrative front matter are excluded.
Two retained article-body declarations disclose generative-AI assistance; those declarations are part of the source text and are not hidden.
source_limitations: All articles come from one English-language journal and one recurring editorial series.
The wave contains scientific and professional guidance rather than a representative sample of primary research or general nonfiction.
The lexical duplicate screen cannot establish absence of paraphrased or semantic overlap.

decision: Accept as a development-only second expansion wave. Preserve 12 separate author/work groups, exclude every inspected article from the future untouched test, and continue acquisition across unrelated publishers and domains before freezing splits.
